concerns.text: Task T031a allows generating a 'synthetic placeholder dataset' if no public source exists, violating FR-010 and Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) which mandate calibration against *real* human pilot data. The task description explicitly permits a fallback that bypasses the mandatory human data requirement, effectively weakening the FR.

Task T035 implements a 'LIMITATION' flag to proceed with simulated-only analysis if real student data (<200 records) is missing. This directly violates FR-011 which states the system 'MUST incorporate real-student interaction data... into the final comparative analysis' and US-7 which requires this for scientific validity. The task silently relaxes a mandatory requirement.

Task T012 explicitly excludes the Khan Academy dataset ('Scope Note: Khan Academy dataset excluded per plan.md summary'). FR-001 mandates ingestion of data from 'the public ASSISTments and Khan Academy datasets'. The task reduces the functional scope without a corresponding amendment to the spec or a formal justification recorded in the spec, constituting a silent weakening of the FR.

Task T023 validates 'no consecutive empty bins > 5s' using 1-second bins. SC-005 requires 'no gaps larger than 5 s' in the distribution. While the logic attempts to approximate this, the task description does not explicitly guarantee the continuous distribution gap constraint defined in SC-005, risking a semantic drift where the validation passes but the success criterion is not met.

Tasks T062 (cognitive depth) and T063 (computational irreducibility) introduce new evaluation dimensions and data collection requirements not present in the Functional Requirements, Success Criteria, or User Stories. This constitutes scope creep and a violation of the constraint that tasks must not introduce unverified empirical values or new metrics without explicit authorization.
